lines: You came up the ladder. Nobody comes up the ladder unless she says so.
Congratulations. Sign the roll on your way out - the UP column.
It is the only column anybody reads.
Counterweight's set, then. She'll have felt that through the floor.
Down you go. Round the water, not through it.
The Stone Hall doesn't have a floor to fight on. It has a mine.
Keeper Quill is at the bottom of it and she is not coming up for you.
Take the cage down. Set the counterweight in the old workings -
three plates, three stones - and the second cage will run.
Terra, when you get to her. Bring something green or something wet.
